baseline_models.focus_anchor: The one construction, نُنَزِّلُ ... شِفَاءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ ... وَلَا يَزِيدُ ... إِلَّا خَسَارًا, assigns opposite recipient-indexed effects to the descending Qur'an.
baseline_models.mechanism: Delivered recitation removes ailment and extends mercy where assent supplies a settled receiving posture; right-blocking resistance converts repeated encounter into growing deficit.

activation_trace.role: Delivery and conveyance make the Qur'an the arriving therapeutic agent.
Reading and recitation identify that agent as enacted discourse.
Cure and release from ailment supply the restorative effect.
Tender mercy supplies beneficent care alongside cure.
Heart-settling assent supplies the believers' receptive posture.
Increase and growth make the adverse result cumulative.
Withholding or blocking a right supplies the resistant posture.
General diminution names what grows under resistant reception.

changed_reading.before: The Qur'an benefits believers but harms wrongdoers.
changed_reading.after: The same delivered recitation acts as a reception-sensitive process: settled assent opens cure and mercy, while right-blocking resistance compounds diminution.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نُنَزِّلُ, شِفَاءٌ, الظَّالِمِينَ, and خَسَارًا can be read together as a placement-and-measure mechanism.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Qur'an gathers material and puts it in its fitting station; healing is restoration of order. Wrongdoing misplaces what arrives, so increase appears paradoxically as ever greater short measure.

activation_trace.role: Putting a thing in its proper station supplies the calibrating action.
Gathering dispersed elements supplies the material to be reordered.
Cure makes right ordering restorative rather than merely classificatory.
Concrete placement in a wrong time or place supplies the inverse operation.
Short measure gives loss a calibration image.
Growth turns repeated miscalibration into compounding undermeasure.

changed_reading.before: Healing and loss are two unrelated outcomes assigned to two groups.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages one calibration event: fitting placement restores, while resistant misplacement repeatedly produces a larger deficit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding dawn recitation is a witnessed breach of night; the vigil sequence then moves from stillness through stirring to a regained station. Healing becomes reactivation, not only removal of disease.

activation_trace.role: Recitation anchors the contextual dawn event back in the focus Qur'an.
Cure is the focus effect re-described as reactivation.
Wide splitting and emergence make dawn an opening through obscurity.
Presence with witnessing makes the opening manifest and attended.
Sleep and stillness supply the dormant state from which change begins.
Stirring what is dormant supplies the transition into renewed activity.
Station and abiding place supply the restored position reached by reactivation.

structural_cues: 17:78 locates repeated Qur'an at dawn and calls it witnessed; 17:79 follows night stillness with being raised to a praised station.
The focus predicates healing of what is sent down from the Qur'an.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dawn-splitting, witnessing, stillness, stirring, and station; I infer the arrow from recited descent to a witnessed reopening into activity. A live alternative is that these are only ritual and temporal framing.

changed_reading.before: Healing is removal of an ailment.
changed_reading.after: In the dawn-vigil sequence, Qur'anic healing can be a witnessed reopening from obscurity and reactivation from stillness into a restored station.

context_deltas.mechanism: Truthful ingress reaches the interior, exposes and draws out hidden corruption, and leaves stable truth where falsehood loses every trace. The sequence supplies a concrete extraction mechanism for شِفَاء.

activation_trace.role: Fitting placement makes the descending treatment enter where it belongs.
Cure anchors the ingress-and-expulsion sequence as therapeutic.
Interior and inwardness locate the treatment below the surface.
Hidden corruption supplies the lesion reached by inward entry.
Complete soundness and stability characterize the desired ingress and egress.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies diagnostic exposure.
A bodily sore emerging makes the extraction materially therapeutic.
Reality-stable truth supplies what remains after extraction.
Departure until the trace is cut supplies the endpoint of expulsion.
Loss of truth and stability identifies the false material that departs.

structural_cues: 17:80 pairs truthful entry with truthful exit before the focus.
17:81 immediately states that truth arrives and falsehood departs, then 17:82 names healing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies interiority, hidden corruption, truthful stability, emergence, and trace-cutting departure; I infer a medicinal arrow in which truthful entry exposes and expels a lesion. A live alternative is a purely spatial or juridical transition.

changed_reading.before: The Qur'an heals by giving beneficial content.
changed_reading.after: The Qur'an heals as truthful ingress: it reaches concealed disorder, brings it out, and establishes what is sound while falsehood loses its trace.

context_deltas.mechanism: Turning away from benefit and collapsing into despair under harm instantiate a receiver's operative direction; each then acts according to that شَاكِلَة. The focus polarity is therefore a feedback process that reveals and reinforces reception posture.

activation_trace.role: Settled assent supplies the receptive configuration associated with cure.
Growth supplies feedback amplification rather than a one-time verdict.
Blocking a right supplies the resistant configuration associated with loss.
Diminution names the state amplified by that resistance.
Turning one's side supplies an enacted refusal of benefit.
Moving away by the side turns refusal into sustained orientation.
Cut-off hope supplies the adverse configuration exposed by harm.
Intentional action makes inner direction behaviorally effective.
A characteristic way and direction names the receiver-specific channel.
Gentle direction toward the true path supplies the contrasting receptive trajectory.

structural_cues: 17:83 pairs blessing with turning away and adverse touch with despair; 17:84 then generalizes action according to each one's شَاكِلَة.
The focus places cure and mercy versus increased loss on opposite recipient labels.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enacted orientations and receiver-specific action; I infer a feedback arrow in which revelation elicits the posture and repeated posture intensifies its outcome. A live alternative is a merely descriptive classification with no amplification mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Two fixed groups simply receive different consequences.
changed_reading.after: The ayah reads as a diagnostic reaction: Qur'anic encounter exposes the receiver's direction and feeds it, opening restoration in assent while deepening deficit in refusal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The spirit is placed under divine command while human knowledge remains slight; revealed communication could be taken away and lacks an independent keeper, yet remains by mercy and gift. Healing becomes preserved life-bearing efficacy, not exhaustive informational possession.

activation_trace.role: Recited revelation anchors the preserved gift in the focus object.
Cure supplies efficacy that need not equal exhaustive comprehension.
Life-bearing spirit supplies the adjacent domain of vivification.
Smallness and paucity limit the recipient's epistemic possession.
Going away makes the revealed resource explicitly removable.
Knowledge imparted in hidden fashion identifies what could be removed.
A keeper sufficient for an affair marks the unavailable independent safeguard.
Merciful care supplies the stated exception that preserves revelation.
Gift and beneficence characterize preservation as granted surplus.

structural_cues: 17:85 joins the spirit to divine command and limits given knowledge.
17:86 makes revelation removable and denies an independent keeper; 17:87 makes mercy and great favor the exception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies life, limited knowledge, possible removal, absent independent custody, mercy, and gift; I infer that preservation is part of the healing mercy and that efficacy can exceed comprehension. A live alternative is that the sequence concerns only custody of revelation.

changed_reading.before: Healing is information possessed and understood by its recipients.
changed_reading.after: Healing is a mercifully preserved, life-bearing gift whose efficacy is not measured by the recipient's small share of knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Qur'an is an unmatchable gathered whole whose examples are repeatedly turned through different forms; refusal responds by covering the truth again. Repeated therapeutic exposure thus becomes either disclosure or compounded occlusion.

activation_trace.role: Gathering and joining make the focus Qur'an a coherent therapeutic whole.
Increase allows repeated exposure to accumulate an effect.
Diminution names the cumulative result of renewed covering.
Joining dispersed parties supplies the attempted collective counter-production.
The gathered Qur'an remains the whole their gathering cannot reproduce.
Likeness and counterpart define the failed production test.
Turning from state to state supplies varied presentation across examples.
The struck example supplies each concrete therapeutic exposure.
Refusal supplies the active rejection between exposure and loss.
Covering the truth supplies the occlusive operation repeated by refusal.

structural_cues: 17:88 opposes the Qur'an's unmatchability to the combined effort of humans and jinn.
17:89 says every kind of example is varied in this Qur'an, yet most people answer with refusal and covering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, failed matching, varied examples, refusal, and covering; I infer that reformulation works like repeated therapeutic exposure and that active re-covering turns repetition into amplified deficit. A live alternative is a didactic demonstration without a therapeutic process.

changed_reading.before: The Qur'an is one curative message accepted or rejected once.
changed_reading.after: Its cure can work through coherent but varied exposures; repeated refusal re-covers each disclosure, so the same repetition accumulates loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The challengers demand falling sky, ascent, and a personally readable descending book, then reject a human messenger; the reply matches messenger kind to the kind securely walking on earth. Against that sequence, healing descent is calibrated delivery to embodied recipients, while the demand for a category-mismatched spectacle reenacts wrong placement.

activation_trace.role: Putting a thing in its fitting station anchors mercy in calibrated delivery.
Recitation identifies the fitted medium actually delivered.
Putting a thing in the wrong place supplies the challengers' category error.
Downward falling supplies the demanded spectacular substitute for revelation.
Detached pieces of sky make that substitute materially coercive.
Ascent by steps supplies the upward half of the demanded display.
Their demanded delivery turns descent into a controllable object on command.
Ordered letters and a written object specify the tangible proof demanded.
Their own reading is made a condition of belief rather than a receiving practice.
A barrier between a person and the desired end names the objection's blocking role.
The visibly embodied human is the messenger category they reject.
Messenger and message identify the rejected delivery relation.
Walking and embodied movement identify the inhabitants whose medium must fit them.
Settled security characterizes the hypothetical angelic recipients.
Fitting placement makes an angelic messenger appropriate only to angelic inhabitants.
Messenger identity completes the medium-recipient matching rule.

structural_cues: 17:90-93 escalate demands from spring and garden to falling sky, ascent, and a personally readable descending book.
17:94 identifies the human messenger as their barrier; 17:95 answers with a messenger matched to the kind walking securely on earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a contrast between coerced physical descent and messenger descent matched to inhabitants; I infer that proper medium-recipient fit is part of healing mercy and that demanding a category mismatch enacts misplacement. A live alternative is only a rebuttal about signs and messenger species.

changed_reading.before: Descent simply means that Qur'anic content comes from above.
changed_reading.after: Descent is merciful calibration: the message arrives in a form fitted to embodied recipients, whereas replacing that fit with coerced spectacle repeats the misplacement that compounds loss.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it connects form-distant pregnancy and womb branches. It remains valid because both ق ر ء and ر ح م are explicit focus roots and ش ف ي keeps the model tied to healing. Render only as an exploratory material analogy, not as lexical disambiguation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قُرْآن, رَحْمَة, and شِفَاء are all explicit focus nouns, while نُنَزِّلُ supplies ordered placement.

activation_trace.role: A womb gathering a pregnancy recasts Qur'anic gathering as protected formation.
The womb as a vessel supplies enclosing mercy and development.
Putting a thing in its station supplies ordered implantation rather than mere arrival.
Cure keeps the formation image directed toward repaired life.

changed_reading.before: Mercy accompanies an externally administered cure.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, Qur'anic mercy is a protected formative space in which repaired life is gathered, placed, and brought toward wholeness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins the hospitality branch of ن ز ل to both the dominant and non-dominant provision mappings carried under focus root ز ي د. The exact packet branches anchor it, but downstream prose must label it a branch-triggered travel analogy rather than the morphology of يَزِيدُ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نُنَزِّلُ and يَزِيدُ are explicit focus verbs, and خَسَارًا supplies the opposite of adequate provision.

activation_trace.role: Prepared hospitality for a guest makes descent an offered ration at a stopping place.
Stored provisions for travel connect increase to what equips a passage.
The split ز و د mapping sharpens the image as carrying provisions for transition.
Merciful care characterizes the host's provision as beneficent.
Diminution supplies the failed journey's progressive depletion.

changed_reading.before: The Qur'an increases either benefit or abstract loss.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the descent offers journey-provision: receptive guests are equipped for passage, while resistant encounter adds only depletion.

strongest_changes: 17:80-81 turns generic healing into truthful ingress, exposure, and expulsion of hidden corruption.
17:83-84 makes the healing-loss polarity a receiver-configuration feedback process.
17:92-95 reframes descent as recipient-fitted delivery rather than demanded spectacle.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots jointly support a calibration model: proper placement and gathering restore, while misplacement and short measure compound loss; context then supplies bodily, behavioral, and messenger-medium mechanisms without collapsing them.
remaining_uncertainties: The branch inventories do not settle whether مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ is partitive or source-marking.
The causal arrow from شَاكِلَة to amplified outcome is reader-supplied; the sequence also permits a merely descriptive contrast.
The gestational and travel-provision outliers are packet-anchored but intentionally form-distant.
